content:
For the characters found at the Mountainside Bed & Breakfast, see Cannibal (Wastelanders).

“Feast on mortal flesh to heal your wounds!”— Perk card description

**Cannibal** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

After feeding on human, ghoul, super mutant, scorched, or mole miner corpses, irradiates the player 10 rads/second for 5 seconds, restores 18.75% of hunger and heals 15 HP/s for 5s. Carnivore mutation doubles food and HP benefit, while Bloodsucker perk removes radiation intake and replenishes 15% of thirst.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Eating human, Ghoul, Super Mutant, Scorched, or Mole Miner corpses restores Health and hunger. | 0004B259 | 

- Eating corpses does not affect the Herbivore mutation negatively.
- Iron Stomach mitigates the rads taken from eating corpses.
- The rads taken from eating corpses will trigger Ghoulish.
- Bloodsucker makes Cannibal restore thirst and no longer irradiate the player.

Eating corpses will satisfy challenges for eating pre-war food.
